# Harrison

[Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea)

## Overview

- **Age:** middle-aged  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007)</sub>
- **Origin:** Scottsford, New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Mr.  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P3](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Harrison is described as a short, fat, and bald man who is not considered handsome even at his most amiable. Despite this, he maintains a neat and snug appearance.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008)_

## Personality

Harrison is a fussy, fidgety, and middle-aged man who has earned a reputation for being an odd crank. Though he prides himself on his outspokenness, which others can find trying, he maintains an outwardly sympathetic and kind nature. He routinely smokes a pipe on his veranda and holds a prejudice against marriage, though he is later described as a changed and much nicer man after remarrying. He is also fastidious and hard to please when reviewing written work.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007), +6 more_

## History

Before settling in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Harrison lived in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), having visited Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) as a boy. Following a promise made to his dying sister, he married [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott and took a fortnight's wedding trip to St. John, though he later kept a bachelor's hall after his sister passed away. Upon moving to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's neighbor, he initially confronted her angrily when a cow broke into his oatfield, but the two formed an unexpected friendship after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally sold his Jersey cow and came to his house with a cake and money to confess. Over time, Harrison offered his opinions on Anne's teaching methods, discussed village news, and survived a severe storm that tragically killed his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md). Eventually, Harrison explained the history of his marriage and past falling out to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), leading to his reunion with his wife [Emily](../character/emily.md). Harrison continued to support Anne's endeavors, providing feedback on her story Averil's Atonement, encouraging her to keep writing despite early magazine rejections, and delivering her mail during a stormy winter holiday.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P24](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0024), +27 more_

## Quotes

> "Sorry, miss! Sorry isn’t going to help matters any. You’d better go and look at the havoc that animal has made in my oats . . . trampled them from center to circumference, miss."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P17](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0017)

> “Who? Mrs. Lynde? Don’t you tell me I’m like that old gossip,” said Mr. Harrison irritably. “I’m not . . . not a bit. What have you got in that box?”
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P27](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0027)

> "I don’t, that’s a fact, and I’m mighty fond of it, too. I’m much obliged to you. It looks good on top. I hope it’s good all the way through."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P29](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0029)

> "Well, I’ll tell you what, miss, you must help me eat it. I’ll put the kettle on and we’ll have a cup of tea. How will that do?"
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P31](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0031)

> "I see you haven’t much confidence in my ability to make tea. You’re wrong . . . I can brew up as good a jorum of tea as you ever drank. But go ahead yourself. Fortunately it rained last Sunday, so there’s plenty of clean dishes."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P34](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0034)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--harrison.md)

Harrison first met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when he angrily confronted her after her cow broke into his oatfield. Their relationship took an unexpected turn after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly sold Harrison's cow and came to his house with the proceeds and a cake to confess, leading the two to share tea and form a close friendship. Despite occasional disagreements over things like village projects or teaching philosophies, they remain neighbors who confide in one another.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), +25 more_

- Friend of — neighbors and friends who confide in each other  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P31](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0031), +1 more</sub>
